raw.query: SELECT run_id, window_name, cost_ratio::numeric(10,4) FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current = true AND run_id IN ('a12:week_encoder_timesfm', 'rerun_verify:fc_p90_burst3_L30') AND denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8';
raw.claimed: Per-pool provisioning holds the tail latency objective through burst onsets that defeat an identically informed reactive controller, at a fraction of the deployable static encoder fleet's GPU-time
raw.evidence: Per-window breakdown fails: during every single burst onset (windows burst1-6), the forecast policy costs 1.95x-2.58x more than the deployable static fleet (e.g. 2.46x on burst3, which defeats the reactive controller); the fraction (0.60x) only holds on the aggregate week-scale window. Additionally, ewma_ablation_cell carries a wrong denominator trap of 3869278.4s for burst3 (true is 12957.6s), artificially yielding a cost ratio of 0.0083.
raw.fix: Clarify that the 'fraction' savings only apply to week-scale aggregates, whereas individual burst onsets are 1.9x to 2.6x more expensive than static. Fix the wrong denominator column in ewma_ablation_cell.
